name: link-depth
hypothesis: A page five links deep is reached by a smaller, more persistent subset of visitors than the same page linked from the main page. Depth-first crawlers should be over-represented in the deep arm.

arms.label: shallow (main page link)
arms.note: adds a 'Filed records' link on Main_Page; the deep path stays

arms.label: deep only
arms.note: reachable only via the depth-5 chain
